text: Computer vision is the field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to understand and interpret visual information from the world, much like humans do. Through image recognition, computers can identify objects, people, and scenes in photos or videos. For example, object detection can locate and label specific items, such as cars, pedestrians, or animals, within a single frame. This technology has many practical applications, from sorting photos on your phone to monitoring security cameras. One of the most exciting uses is in self-driving cars, where computer vision helps vehicles recognize traffic lights, road signs, and obstacles in real time, making autonomous driving safer and more reliable.
